info.title: API.SH: Galaxus
info.description: The Galaxus API from API.SH: public Galaxus data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.summary: Galaxus stock per size and colour
get.description:
Live stock of every size of the product's colour (with `all_colors=true`: every colour too, up to 16 colours): for each variant its product number, colour and size with their variant ids, price, availability class, in-stock flag, available quantity and stock source, delivery estimate (date or date range) and pickup per store with the time it can be collected (pickup only where the shop sells the item itself). Also lists the product's colours.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/galaxus-availability

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A product link on galaxus.ch, galaxus.de, galaxus.at, galaxus.fr, galaxus.it, galaxus.nl, galaxus.be or digitec.ch; its shop, country and language are used unless given. Give this or `id`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The product number (the digits at the end of a product link, e.g. 6306163). Each colour and size of an item is its own product number.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market: sets the shop, prices (CHF in CH, EUR elsewhere), stock and delivery estimates. Default: the link's market, else CH.

parameters.name: shop
parameters.description: galaxus (default) or digitec (the Swiss sister shop, same catalog; country CH).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of names, specifications and texts. Default: the link's language, else the market's own (de for CH/DE/AT).

parameters.name: all_colors
parameters.description: true: every colour's sizes, not just the given product's colour. Costs 5 credits instead of 1.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: galaxus.de only: a 5-digit German postcode for the delivery estimate.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The shop's category tree: without `category` the top-level sectors with their sub-categories; with a category id that category's children and grandchildren (id, name, link, leaf flag) and its most visited product types. Ids go to /galaxus/v1/category.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/galaxus-categories

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category id from this endpoint (default: the top level).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market (default CH).

parameters.name: shop
parameters.description: galaxus (default) or digitec (the Swiss sister shop, same catalog; country CH).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of names, specifications and texts. Default: the link's language, else the market's own (de for CH/DE/AT).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The products of a category (product type, tag or sector page) with filters, sort and paging, as on the shop's category pages; `facets` lists the category's filters with counts.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/galaxus-category

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A category link (…/producttype/…, …/tag/… or …/sector/…); its own ?filter= is applied. Give this or `category`.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category id from /galaxus/v1/categories.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market: sets the shop, prices (CHF in CH, EUR elsewhere), stock and delivery estimates. Default: the link's market, else CH.

parameters.name: shop
parameters.description: galaxus (default) or digitec (the Swiss sister shop, same catalog; country CH).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of names, specifications and texts. Default: the link's language, else the market's own (de for CH/DE/AT).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, rating, availability (fastest delivery first), newest.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A filter from `facets` as facet:option (e.g. bra:16579 for a brand, off:Sale for clearance, off:InStock); several options of one facet as bra:16579|786. Repeat the parameter or separate with commas for several facets.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price in the market's currency.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price in the market's currency.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page, 1-200 (default 1). Use `next_page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Products per page, 1-48 (default 24).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Galaxus or digitec product in one market: product number, name, brand, the selected colour and size with their variant ids, GTIN, manufacturer part number, price and price before VAT with the ISO currency (CHF, EUR), previous price and discount, labels and promotion, availability class and live stock (quantity, stock source, delivery estimate, pickup per store when the shop sells it itself), the seller of the shown offer (Galaxus or a marketplace seller) and the number of offers, every variant group (colour, size, other) with each option's product number, price, availability and link, rating and review count, number of questions, rank in its category, a price-history summary, category and breadcrumbs, description, highlights, key and full specifications, warranties, return policy and images. 404 when the product number does not exist.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/galaxus-product

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/galaxus-reviews

get.description:
Products matching a search in one market, with every filter the shop offers for it (`facets`, with counts), quick filters, sort and paging. Each product has its product number, name, brand, size or properties, price and previous price with ISO currency, availability class, seller, rating and images. A search the shop answers with a category page (e.g. a category name) returns that category's products (`redirected_to_category`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/galaxus-search

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
